## Epidemic phase

```{r}
raw = read.csv("Data/raw_data.csv")
```

```{r}
oracle <- raw %>%
  group_by(location, target_end_date) %>%
  slice_max(reference_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  distinct(location, target_end_date, oracle_value) %>%
  arrange(location, target_end_date)

trend_df <- oracle %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  mutate(
    MA3        = rollmean(oracle_value, k = 3, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    pct_change = (MA3 - lag(MA3)) / lag(MA3) * 100,
    trend = case_when(
      pct_change > 5  ~ "Increasing",
      pct_change < -5 ~ "Decreasing",
      TRUE            ~ "Stable"
    ),
    trend = factor(trend, levels = c("Decreasing", "Stable", "Increasing"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(location, target_end_date, trend)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(trend_df, by = c("location", "target_end_date"))

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))
nrow(standard_wis) 

sum(is.na(log_standard_wis$trend))
nrow(standard_wis) 
```

## Pop data

```{r}
# county
counties_sf <- counties(cb = TRUE, year = 2022) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, STATEFP)

# OMB MSA delineation file
library(readxl)
## you can download this data from here https://www.census.gov/programs-surveys/metro-micro/about/delineation-files.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com
msa <- read_excel("Data/list1_2023.xlsx",skip = 2)
msa <- msa %>%
  mutate(
    GEOID = sprintf("%02d%03d",
                    as.numeric(`FIPS State Code`),
                    as.numeric(`FIPS County Code`))
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(GEOID, `CBSA Code`)

# county → state → MSA 연결
state_msa <- counties_sf %>%
  left_join(msa, by = "GEOID") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`CBSA Code`))

# state별 MSA 개수
msa_count <- state_msa %>%
  group_by(STATEFP) %>%
  summarise(MSA_count = n_distinct(`CBSA Code`))

st_sf <- tigris::states(cb = TRUE, year = 2022)

st_name <- st_sf %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::select(STATEFP, NAME) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

msa_count <- msa_count %>%
  left_join(st_name, by = "STATEFP") %>%
  rename(n_msa = MSA_count)
```

```{r}
locations <- read.csv("Data/locations.csv")

state_pop <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = "B01003_001",  # total population
  year = 2023,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide"
) %>%
  dplyr::select(state = NAME, population = B01003_001E)

standard_wis <- standard_wis %>%
  left_join(locations %>% 
              dplyr::select(state, location, population), 
            by = c("location")) %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = "state", suffix = c("",".state")) %>%
  left_join(msa_count %>%
              dplyr::select(-STATEFP), by = c("state" = "NAME")) %>%
  mutate(pop_ratio = population/population.state)


log_standard_wis <- log_standard_wis %>%
  left_join(locations %>% 
              dplyr::select(state, location, population), 
            by = c("location")) %>% 
  left_join(state_pop, by = "state", suffix = c("",".state")) %>%
  left_join(msa_count %>%
              dplyr::select(-STATEFP), by = c("state" = "NAME")) %>%
  mutate(pop_ratio = population/population.state)
```

## Join

```{r}
exclude_cols <- c("overprediction", "underprediction", "dispersion", "coverage_50", "coverage_90")

complete_wis <- state_wis %>%
  select(-any_of(exclude_cols)) %>%
  left_join(
    standard_wis %>% select(-any_of(exclude_cols)),
    by = setdiff(
      intersect(colnames(state_wis), colnames(standard_wis)),
      exclude_cols
    )
  )


complete_wis <- complete_wis %>%
  filter(wis > 0)
```

```{r}
exclude_cols <- c("overprediction", "underprediction", "dispersion", "coverage_50", "coverage_90")

log_complete_wis <- log_state_wis %>%
  select(-any_of(exclude_cols)) %>%
  left_join(
    log_standard_wis %>% select(-any_of(exclude_cols)),
    by = setdiff(
      intersect(colnames(state_wis), colnames(standard_wis)),
      exclude_cols
    )
  )


log_complete_wis <- log_complete_wis %>%
  filter(wis > 0)
```

## Filtered

```{r}
complete_wis_filtered <- complete_wis %>%
  # filter(wis > 0, state_wis > 0) %>%
  rename(wis_local = wis, wis_state = state_wis) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(wis_local, wis_state),
    names_to = "geo_granularity",
    values_to = "all_wis",
    names_prefix = "wis_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(local = geo_granularity == "local")
```

```{r}
log_complete_wis_filtered <- log_complete_wis %>%
  # filter(wis > 0, state_wis > 0) %>%
  rename(wis_local = wis, wis_state = state_wis) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(wis_local, wis_state),
    names_to = "geo_granularity",
    values_to = "all_wis",
    names_prefix = "wis_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(local = geo_granularity == "local")
```

# Model effects

## New models

### Normal and Gamma with log link family (NG)

```{r}
# This model now includes on the as an outcome variable all WIS scores (we should discuss if these are log-transformed or natural) and on the RHS an indicator variable for whether that WIS is from a local model (local = TRUE) or whether it is from a state model applied to local data (local = FALSE). 
# NG <- glmer(
#   all_wis ~ local * (model_id + horizon + n_msa + pop_ratio) +
#     (1 | location) + (1 | target_end_date) + 
#     (0 + as.numeric(local) | location),
#   family = Gamma(link = "log"),
#   data = complete_wis_filtered,
#   subset = all_wis > 0
# )
# 
# summary(NG)
# This means that exp(beta_local) is the average multipliative effect of being a local model (>1 means it worsens performance, <1 means it improves performance). The intercept is the average score.
# And the the location/model/horizon random effects tell you the additional multiplicative effect of location/model/horizon have specifically on the local model's performance, on top of the avergae local effect capture by beta_local.
```

## Gamma models

```{r}
all_wis_gamma <- glmmTMB(
  all_wis ~ local * (model_id + horizon + n_msa + pop_ratio) + model_id * (horizon + trend) +
    (1 | location) + (1 | target_end_date) + (1 | reference_date) +
    (0 + as.numeric(local) | location),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = complete_wis_filtered,
  subset = all_wis > 0,
  control = glmmTMBControl(
    parallel = 4,
    optCtrl = list(iter.max = 2000, eval.max = 3000)
  )
)

```

```{r}
all_wis_gamma$fit$convergence  # should be 0
all_wis_gamma$fit$message
all_wis_gamma$sdr$pdHess       # should be TRUE

diagnose(all_wis_gamma)
VarCorr(all_wis_gamma)

sim_res <- simulateResiduals(
  fittedModel = all_wis_gamma,
  n = 500,
  seed = 123
)

plot(sim_res)

testUniformity(sim_res)
testDispersion(sim_res)
testOutliers(sim_res)
```

```{r}
summary(all_wis_gamma)
```

```{r}

emm <- emmeans(
  all_wis_gamma,
  ~ local | model_id * horizon,
  at = list(
    local = c(FALSE, TRUE),
    n_msa = mean(complete_wis_filtered$n_msa, na.rm = TRUE),
    pop_ratio = mean(complete_wis_filtered$pop_ratio, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  weights = "equal"
)

ratios <- contrast(
  emm,
  method = list("Local / state" = c(-1, 1))
)

ratio_df <- as.data.frame(
  confint(ratios, type = "response", adjust = "none")
)

ggplot(ratio_df, aes(x = ratio, y = model_id)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_segment(aes(
    x = asymp.LCL, xend = asymp.UCL,
    yend = model_id
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ horizon, labeller = label_both) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Local / state expected WIS (95% CI)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```


```{r}
no_ref_model =glmmTMB(
  all_wis ~ local * (model_id + horizon + n_msa + pop_ratio) + model_id * (horizon + trend) +
```

### Log version

```{r}
log1p_all_wis_gamma <- glmmTMB(
  all_wis ~ local * (model_id + horizon + n_msa + pop_ratio) + model_id * (horizon + trend) +
    (1 | location) + (1 | target_end_date) + (1 | reference_date) +
    (0 + as.numeric(local) | location),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = log_complete_wis_filtered,
  subset = all_wis > 0,
  control = glmmTMBControl(
    parallel = 4,
    optCtrl = list(iter.max = 2000, eval.max = 3000)
  )
)
```
